title: The Degradation Paradox: Why Draining Depth Kills Performance

beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The Degradation Paradox unlocks 98.2% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A plot showing error rate rising as depth increases beyond a critical threshold.

visual_blueprint.title: THE DEGRADATION PARADOX
visual_blueprint.sub: Training error increases as networks grow deeper

motif_params.title: THE DEGRADATION PARADOX
motif_params.sub: Training error increases as networks grow deeper

beats.text: The culprit is the gradient flow, which gets diluted like a signal passing through a thousand miles of copper wire.
beats.visual_focus: A signal waveform flattening out as it traverses sequential network layers.

beats.text: Instead of forcing layers to learn the entire transformation, Enter ResNet: Deep Residual Learni: a skip connection that preserves the input signal directly.
beats.visual_focus: An identity shortcut bypassing two weight layers to connect previous activations.
